description: Writes a concise public-source report on a project (name, ticker, or token address): what it does, team, tokenomics, market snapshot, news, and risks. Use for a project overview; for a specific contract address use `contract_research`, for DefiLlama TVL and fees use `protocol_stats_snapshot`; paid 0.83 USDC via x402.

chain.description: Optional chain to disambiguate a token address.

project.description: Project name, ticker, or token contract address.

name: project_research_report

outputSchema.description: Markdown research report covering overview, tokenomics, market data, recent developments, risks, and a verdict, with source links.

title: Project Research Report
